submission.justification:
Radiator-R2 at 3 cm thickness is recommended as it provides the best pion/kaon separation performance at 10 GeV/c with a separation of 4.55σ (averaged from multiple simulations: 4.619σ and 4.481σ). This represents a 12.3% performance advantage over the next best option (R1 at 3.99σ) and a 51% advantage over R3 (3.01σ).

While R2 has identified moisture vulnerability due to its porous aerogel structure, this durability concern can be effectively mitigated through proper engineering controls such as encapsulation, hermetic sealing, or protective coatings - standard practices in detector construction. The significant performance advantage (4.55σ vs 3.99σ) justifies R2 selection, as this superior separation capability is critical for hadron identification quality throughout the experiment's lifetime.

The 3 cm thickness represents the optimal point where R2 achieves maximum separation, balancing photon yield with angular resolution. This thickness is well within the 1-6 cm constraint and provides robust performance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: R2 at 3 cm provides 4.55σ separation (average of 4.619σ and 4.481σ), which is the highest among all candidates and thicknesses tested. This outperforms R1 (3.99σ) by 12.3% and R3 (3.01σ) by 51%.

requirements.requirement: Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is one of the three candidates evaluated (R1, R2, R3).

requirements.requirement: Radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime
requirements.evidence: While R2 has moisture vulnerability identified (porous aerogel without inherent protection), this can be mitigated through standard engineering controls (hermetic sealing, protective coatings, encapsulation). With proper protection measures, R2 can maintain performance over the experiment's lifetime, similar to how R1's hydrophobic protection addresses its durability needs.
The recommended thickness of 3 cm is within the specified range of 1-6 cm.
